latin: Cum dicit Aristoteles quod oportet prima principia semper permanere, nihil aliud intendit nisi quod in qualibet transmutatione reperiuntur.
translation: When Aristotle says that first principles must always remain, he means nothing other than that they are found present in every change.
translator: original translation, drafted 2026-09-26 by WRITER-light-batch2, from Latin at farmer1998:14482
